The money tile 344 px below it reads 'Breaks in the day 76' with the label 'this live plan, see below', and the divergence sentence under that names the saved plan explicitly ('differs from the weekly plan saved to disk (1,067,846 ILS, 80 breaks) ... -4 breaks'). The new sentence says only 'the day's 80 breaks'. Two answers to how many breaks this day has, on one page, one of them unattributed. THE FIX, one pass, entirely inside files P3 owns, and it is the one round 3 prescribed and round 4 did not build: compute the covers block in kairos_api/day_api.py, which already holds both frames build_break_operations reads, and expose per-programme planned_breaks beside the capped break_markers (the payload carries only the capped figure today, which is why the frontend cannot state the 13 on its own). Then the sentence reads what it has to read: this timeline draws 8 of the 13 breaks the saved weekly plan places in the 12 programmes it shows, out of the 80 that plan holds for this day, across 12 of its 82 programmes, on 1 of the plan's 30 days. Name the basis in the clause that carries the 80, and either point the link at something that holds the rest or say plainly that the day board re-plans this day live and holds a different 76.
